## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 tools/build.py` ends without an error
- [ ] A changed rule has a test, and `origin` says `playbook` or `extension`
- [ ] Coaching text exists in English and Hebrew
- [ ] `SKILL.md` and `SKILL_HE.md` changed together, if either changed
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes
- [ ] Anything borrowed from another project is credited the way `CONTRIBUTING.md` describes under "Credit what you borrow", with a link to the source in the commit message
